race.description: Carlton Draught Ollie Cox Memorial Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: JUST CALL ME JONNY (1) was bought out of NZ last season, and had been showing up at the jump-outs this prep prior to finishing close up in fifth when making his Australian debut at Ararat nearly 3 weeks ago over 1600m. The extra 450m is where he is most comfortable, and with another strong recent jump-out behind him, he can take this out. VICTRIX SWAN (12) stepped up in trip to 1800m for the first time, and immediately broke her maiden status out of her class at Gundagai. She cops a better gate this time, and has the talent to make further progress this season. Stick with her. SHE'S STARGAZING (8) has mixed her form, and had excuses for a modest effort at Donald 12 days ago over 2200m. She has had some gear changes since then, and is worth another chance. SURELY SPECIAL (9) is a durable veteran racing in career best form as a 9YO gelding. He cops a wide gate for this, but has to be included. SORRY SUNSHINE (6) jumps the border, and is holding his form strongly. Each way claims again.
